_about: The N-565 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The address (the USCIS Phoenix Lockbox, Attn: N-565, P.O. Box 20050: uscis.gov/n-565, updated 06/01/2026), the subject and the fee ($555, $0 for a USCIS error: Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/n565.py. checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
Enclose the N-565 fee the cover letter states by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check.
